analysis.reply_text: first, move closer to the router and watch if the drops stop, because that rules out weak signal. Next, restart your router and modem: unplug them, wait about ten seconds, then plug them back in and let them fully reconnect. Then, on your device, toggle Wi‑Fi off and back on, and forget and rejoin the network if it still acts flaky. After that, check for interference: move the router away from thick walls, microwaves, and crowded spots, and try a different channel in the router settings. Next, update your device’s Wi‑Fi driver or operating system, and also check for router firmware updates. Finally, if it still drops, test another device on the same network, and if both fail, contact your internet provider or replace the router.
